source.title: Source and scope.
source.text: The estimate follows Receita rules for mora penalty and mora interest on social-security contributions, using a local Sicalc Selic snapshot from 2026-07-06.
source.disclaimer: Does not calculate principal, validate regularization rights, or replace official guides and service channels.

multa.label: Mora penalty

howToCalculate.title: How INSS arrears penalty and interest are estimated
howToCalculate.p1: Enter the original contribution amount and dates. The penalty uses 0.33% per late day, capped at 20% of principal.
howToCalculate.p2: Interest uses Selic from the month after due through the month before payment, plus 1% in the payment month.

selfService.title: When INSS arrears may be handled through Meu INSS
selfService.p1: For contribuinte individual, INSS describes self-service for the last 5 years. For facultativo, the simple window is 6 months.
selfService.p2: Outside those windows, old, retroactive, activity-proof, or contribution-difference cases may require Central 135, APS, or official review.

selicPenalty.title: Selic interest, mora penalty, and the 20% cap
selicPenalty.p1: The post-2008 contribution penalty is daily and capped at 20%, so long delays stop increasing the penalty after the cap.
selicPenalty.p2: Selic depends on the payment month. This version uses the 2026-07-06 snapshot, with latest Selic available for 06/2026.

officialDifference.title: Why the official GPS amount can differ
officialDifference.text: SAL, Sicalc, Meu INSS, and Receita may account for holidays, category, payment code, period, evidence, prior payments, and rules not modeled here.

notIncluded.title: What this calculator does not include
notIncluded.p1: It does not issue guides, calculate principal, validate CNIS, retirement, grace period, DIC, old periods, indemnity, MEI, eSocial, PGFN, or installment plans.
notIncluded.p2: It also does not replace an accountant, lawyer, INSS, Receita Federal, Central 135, APS, SAL, Sicalc, PGMEI, or official systems.

q1.question: Does the calculator issue an official GPS?
q1.answer: No. It estimates legal additions for study and does not generate a guide, barcode, payment line, or official document.

q2.question: Can I pay late INSS for any year?
q2.answer: Not always. Older periods can require evidence, indemnity, DIC, decadence review, or INSS service. This version blocks periods before 2008-12.

q3.question: How does the mora penalty work?
q3.answer: This version applies 0.33% per day, capped at 20% of the original amount.

q4.question: How is Selic interest applied?
q4.answer: It uses Selic from the month after due through the month before payment, plus 1% in the payment month.

q5.question: Does it work for facultativo?
q5.answer: Only as a limited estimate. Facultativo competences outside 6 months may require official review and may not be valid just by paying.

q6.question: Does it work for MEI?
q6.answer: No. MEI/DAS/PGMEI has its own scope and is not included in this calculator.

q7.question: Does paying the estimate guarantee retirement time?
q7.answer: No. CNIS acceptance, grace period, insured status, CTC, and benefits depend on official rules and validation.

q8.question: Why do I need to enter the original amount?
q8.answer: Because this version calculates only penalty and interest over a user-supplied principal. It does not define contribution salary, GPS code, ceiling, floor, or the right to pay.
